scope: 用户选定人员汇总表后的单版深化：只读负责人统计与项目明细联动
prompt:
Refine the attached SELECTED Chinese Project Manage UI design into ONE improved high-fidelity desktop concept. Target 1920 x 1080, matching the attached landscape 16:9 aspect ratio. This is a targeted refinement of the user's chosen personnel statistics layout, not a new product or new set of unrelated options. Preserve the top global navigation and existing green/light visual system. User's hard scope: ONLY simple personnel and project statistical analysis. NO daily reports, task generation, scheduling, assignment editing, AI workflows, performance ranking or utilization. The current design's flaw is two disconnected counts tables. Replace them with ONE coherent master-detail relationship: project responsible-name summary -> selected owner's projects and their task status.

Create realistic, production-quality UI with clear hierarchy, strong legible Chinese typography and purposeful spacing. Focus on the main analytic question: “每位负责人有哪些项目，这些项目的任务情况如何？” Use aligned text and thin dividers rather than nested cards. Avoid large empty heading regions, decorative dashboards, gauge charts or extra feature inventory. Body text 15–16px equivalent, heading about 28px; PingFang SC / Inter. Colors: white #ffffff, page #f3f5f9, navy text #1d293d, muted #5a697f, green #218343. Restrained amber for blocked counts and red only for explicit overdue. Maintain source app's Project Manage logo and header: 项目 / 任务 / 团队(active) / 活动记录 / 项目地图. No browser/device frame or multiple concepts.

HEADER:
Team subtabs 通讯录 / 统计分析 selected, neatly tucked under global navigation.
Heading “人员与项目统计”, a short subtitle “看负责人对应的项目，也看项目里的任务状态”.
Compact context text to right of title “17 名在职人员 · 5 个部门”, NOT four huge directory number cards.
Small date in far right “效果预览 · 2026年10月17日”.
One low-height horizontal summary strip with 5 relevant current counts: 项目 39 / 项目内任务 116 / 未完成 82 / 待协调 6 / 明确逾期 1. These are simple type groups with vertical separators, not large icon tiles. Tiny undertext near overdue “仅依据已填截止日”.

FILTER TOOLBAR:
Segmented view selector “项目负责人” selected / “任务负责人” unselected. This makes the two different relationships explicit.
Search field “搜索负责人或项目”; dropdown “全部项目阶段”; compact toggles “全部” selected / “有待协调” / “有逾期”.
Beneath as quiet scope line: “当前按项目负责人填写姓名汇总；任务数来自其负责项目，不代表本人执行量。” Do not join account identities or text names to a directory person.

BODY: large useful master-detail area; left about 66%, right about 34%, with generous readable table columns and one slim vertical gap. Both panels align at their top, minimal borders.
LEFT main title “负责人汇总”; secondary small “点击姓名或数字，查看对应项目”.
A dense but readable table with headers:
“负责人（填写姓名）” / “负责项目” / “项目内任务” / “未完成” / “已完成” / “待协调” / “明确逾期”.
Exact current local data in rows, no changes or invented values:
叶晨曦 | 13 | 41 | 29 | 12 | 3 | 0
于谦 | 8 | 28 | 16 | 12 | 1 | 1
郑元杰 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 0
瞿士翔 | 3 | 9 | 9 | 0 | 0 | 0
朱金玲 | 1 | 9 | 9 | 0 | 0 | 0
王鑫 | 1 | 7 | 2 | 5 | 0 | 0
其他姓名组 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 1 | 0
未填写负责人 | 6 | 13 | 8 | 5 | 1 | 0
Footer bold “合计 | 39 | 116 | 82 | 34 | 6 | 1”.
Highlight 叶晨曦 row with pale green background and a thin green selection edge. The selected row is what the right pane represents. Clickable project counts green, normal task counts navy, nonzero blocked counts small amber text, only explicit overdue 1 subdued red. No misleading share bar or decorative progress bar. Numeric columns right aligned. Task total MUST equal open plus done in each row. Blocked and overdue are subsets, not additive categories. Group headers/column alignment should make semantics obvious and fast to scan.

RIGHT linked pane:
Header “叶晨曦 · 负责项目” and small “13 个项目 / 41 项项目内任务”.
Compact phase summary in one or two text lines, not five metric cards: “实施中 7 · 方案与报价 2 · 验收后运营 2 · 潜在需求 1 · 阶段待补 1”.
Below a tidy read-only PROJECT DETAIL LIST with slim row separators; enough room to read names fully. Header line “项目明细” and quiet selector “待协调优先”.
Five exact project rows, each has a name, phase on same or next line, and three small number columns labelled “任务 / 未完成 / 待协调”:
五粮液项目 — 实施中 — 6 / 4 / 1
北二项目 — 实施中 — 6 / 5 / 0
宁波港北二能耗改造升级 — 方案与报价 — 6 / 2 / 0
仑东所项目 — 实施中 — 4 / 2 / 0
美象·太仓项目 — 实施中 — 4 / 3 / 0
Important: Do NOT claim this partial list is globally sorted by blocked count; display selector instead “默认顺序” because remaining projects include 2 blocked tasks. Use “默认顺序”.
Footer small “当前展示 5 / 13 个项目” and simple green text link “查看全部 13 个项目 →”.
Optionally a slim bottom summarizing line “其余 8 个项目：未完成 13 · 待协调 2” to make partial scope clear.
No edit buttons, assignment forms or giant call-to-action. The single action is inspecting underlying projects.

BOTTOM FOOTNOTES clear but unobtrusive, max two lines:
“待协调、逾期均计入未完成；无截止日期的任务不判断逾期。”
“负责人按现有文字分组，尚未确认人员身份。项目内任务不等于本人任务。”
Small data-quality context can show “6 个项目未填写负责人” as a quiet link near table footer, not a warning banner or remediation workflow.

Accuracy constraints: current date 2026-10-17 Asia/Shanghai, live read-only aggregate revision156 (do NOT show technical revision in UI). Exactly 39 projects, 116 effective leaf tasks, 82 open, 34 done, 6 blocked, 1 explicitly overdue; 6 tasks in whole workspace have a due date. The data reflects current state, not “completed this week”. Do not fabricate trend comparisons, workload, latest activity dates or individual task counts. The current refined screen is a proposed UI, keep “效果预览”. Make it noticeably more informative and space-efficient than the reference while retaining the same calm familiar look.
